**`app/app.go`**

```go
11→
12→// Lookup reads key from s, falling back to config.Default.
13→func Lookup(s store.Store, key string) string {
14→	if v := s.Get(key); v != "" {
15→		return v
16→	}
17→	return config.Default
18→}
19→
20→// All reads key from every backend.
21→func All(key string) []string {
22→	return []string{
23→		Lookup(mem.New(), key),
24→		Lookup(&disk.Cache{Dir: "/tmp"}, key),
25→		Lookup(remote.Client{URL: "https://example.com"}, key),
26→	}
27→}
```

**`disk/cache.go`**

```go

2→package disk
3→

6→
```
